read.thesis: Q4 organic sales +3% with volume gains everywhere, but refinish destocking caps segment EBITDA leverage; 2026 organic guided flat to low single digit and EPS up mid-single digit, back-half weighted. Capex peaking, falling to ~3% of sales by 2027.

capex.quote: we expect to sequentially pace back to our historical levels of approximately 3% of sales by 2027

triggers.label: Refinish destocking through 1H26
triggers.quote: destocking for two quarters, sales volume and EBIT growth in Q3 and Q4

triggers.label: Capex peaks 2025, falls to ~3% of sales
triggers.quote: 2025 will represent the high watermark of these growth investments

triggers.label: Dec US accident claims only -2%
triggers.quote: the December year-over-year claims were down only 2% compared to high single-digit or low double-digit declines throughout the year

triggers.label: Architectural pricing positive 39 quarters
triggers.quote: We have now delivered positive pricing for thirty-nine consecutive quarters in this business

triggers.label: Aerospace capacity constrained, high-single-digit growth
triggers.quote: We are capacity constrained. No doubt about it.

guidance.quote: This will result in organic sales growth in the range of flat to positive low single-digit percentage.

guidance.value: mid-single-digit % at midpoint; 1H flat to low single digit, 2H high single digit
guidance.quote: We expect earnings per share to be flat to growth of low single-digit percentage during the first half of the year and increasing to high single-digit percentage in the second half of the year.
resulting in expected overall flat raw material costs for the year
reducing our cost by another $50 million
we expect to sequentially pace back to our historical levels of approximately 3% of sales by 2027

red_flags.label: Refinish destocking margin drag
red_flags.quote: The biggest issue with our lack of leverage with the volume growth that we're getting today is first, second, and third. The refinish destocking.

red_flags.label: Higher interest and tax cost
red_flags.quote: So, unfortunately, our interest costs are higher. In '26 versus '25.

evasions.quote: Flattish for Q1, low single digits ish for Q2.
